name: relentless-decs-codex
description: DECS v2 session bootstrap, decision-hygiene hook, and MCP server for Relentless projects, packaged for Codex CLI. Same four provenance/session behaviors as the Claude Code plugin (decs/plugin), expressed in Codex-native primitives (config.toml-shaped hooks.json, bearer_token_env_var MCP auth). Verified against codex-cli 0.146.0 — hook system existence and hook-invoked outbound HTTP were empirically probed live (throwaway CODEX_HOME, no real credential), not assumed from docs alone.

interface.shortDescription: DECS v2 session bootstrap, awareness, and decision hygiene for Relentless projects
interface.longDescription: Registers this Codex session with a Relentless project's DECS v2 credential, bootstraps prior decisions and open questions at session start, and prompts a decision-hygiene review before the session ends. Publishes the twenty-one agent-reachable DECS semantic actions as MCP tools, including the three reads that let an agent recall what a project has already decided and planned.
